05 / A little more context

Good questions.
Clear answers.

What do you work on?+

I work across web interfaces, APIs, content systems, and deployment pipelines. My main tools include SvelteKit, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.

Where are you based?+

St. Louis, Missouri. I’m currently a software engineer at Arrows Up and studied computer science with a mathematics minor at Missouri State University.

Can I try the projects?+

Yes. Scribsy has a sample visit, and Narrator has a demo author studio. Both are linked from the selected work gallery and can be explored without signing up.

Where can I read the research?+

My gene classification benchmark has a research page and working manuscript. It reports similarity-aware evaluation and uncertainty, including results that did not establish an advantage for fine-tuning.
